performance.verdict: Meta efficiency is real, but Google's $1,016 in 28 days with 0 conversions is the live bleed.

findings.text: Google Ads: $1,015.77 spent over 28 days, 0 conversions recorded. Top campaign 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' alone burned $736.30 with no measurable return.
Meta CPL dropped 31.05% week-over-week; 3-day lead signal (Aug 19–21: 12+8+8=28) vs prior 3 days (Aug 16–18: 2+7+9=18) confirms the efficiency gain is holding.
SOW milestone overdue: Stripe Products QA marked done 2026-07-20, but GHL shows 0 opportunities won and $0 opportunity value across 140 created — verification of money paths not confirmed.
GHL intake leak probable: 155 leads drove 140 opportunities created but 0 won, 0 appointments, and 178 contacts — leads are arriving but not converting to pipeline movement.
GBP actions fell 54.55% week-over-week (29 total over 28 days, 0 calls); organic reach is not supplementing paid and GBP call tracking may be broken given 28 directions but 0 calls.

suggestions.text: Pause 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' immediately — $736.30 spent in 28 days with 0 conversions confirmed.
suggestions.monday_update: Pause 'BWS - Search Campaign - Calls' pending conversion tracking audit — $736.30 has been spent over 28 days with zero recorded conversions, confirmed by both the 28-day totals and the daily series. Before resuming, verify whether the zero-conversion read is a pixel/tracking gap (client-side issue) or genuine zero performance; if tracking is confirmed working and conversions are truly zero, the campaign does not restart. Success check: by 2026-08-25, confirm tracking status with the client and document finding in the account.

suggestions.text: Raise Meta daily budget +20%; confirmed CPL drop of 31.05% and 3-day lead signal of 28 leads justify a step increase.
suggestions.monday_update: Increase Meta daily budget by 20% from current level (~$87–$105/day range seen in series). CPL fell 31.05% week-over-week and the 3-day lead count (Aug 19–21) reached 28 vs 18 in the prior 3 days — efficiency is confirmed, not a one-day spike. Watch CPL over the next 3 days: if it rises above the 28-day baseline of $16.84, revert the increase. Re-check on 2026-08-25.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake flow — 140 opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments signals a post-lead drop-off requiring Ops review.
suggestions.monday_update: With 155 leads and 140 opportunities created but 0 wins and 0 appointments, leads are entering the pipeline and stalling — this is an intake/follow-up issue, not an ads problem. Escalate to Nacer (Ops) to trace the stage at which opportunities are going cold, and cross-reference with the overdue Stripe/BWS verification milestone (due 2026-07-20). Success check: at least one stage-progression event or appointment booked within the pipeline by 2026-08-29, confirming the workflow is moving contacts forward.
